title.zh: 将莱特省塔邦塔邦市镇的塔邦塔邦描笼涯中学更名为Justimbaste-remandaban国立中学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Tabontabon Barangay High School in the Municipality of Tabontabon, Province of Leyte, to Justimbaste-remandaban National High School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Tabontabon Barangay High School in the Municipality of Tabontabon, Province of Leyte, to Justimbaste-remandaban National High School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1994/ra_7701_1994.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Tabontabon Barangay High School in the Municipality of Tabontabon, Province of Leyte, is hereby changed to Justimbaste-Remandaban National High School, which shall be under the supervision of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports.

The amount necessary for its conversion and eventual operation shall be included in the annual appropriations of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports under the General Appropriations Act. Thereafter, the sum needed for its operation and maintenance shall be included in the General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
